topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stumbled upon it, my words, my thoughts, laid out in the open on the school's website. An example, they called it. My application essay, under a spotlight I never asked for. It’s like a secret I kept to myself is now a shared story, and everyone can read the lines I poured over in the quiet of my room. I find myself adjusting the collar of my shirt, as if it’s suddenly too tight, and I can’t help but wonder how many eyes have already passed over my sentences, whether they felt the same echoes, the same hesitations, as I did when the words first formed on the page.
